<template>
  <v-form @submit.prevent="submitForm">
    <v-text-field
      v-model="username"
      label="Username"
      required
      :error-messages="errors.username"
    ></v-text-field>
    <v-text-field
      v-model="email"
      label="Email"
      type="email"
      required
      :error-messages="errors.email"
    ></v-text-field>
    <v-text-field
      v-model="password"
      label="Password"
      type="password"
      required
      :error-messages="errors.password"
    ></v-text-field>
    <v-text-field
      v-model="confirmPassword"
      label="Confirm Password"
      type="password"
      required
      :error-messages="passwordMismatchError"
    ></v-text-field>
    <v-btn type="submit" color="primary" block :loading="loading">Register</v-btn>
  </v-form>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'

export default {
  props: {
    loading: Boolean,
    errors: {
      type: Object,
      default: () => ({})
    }
  },
  setup(props, { emit }) {
    const username = ref('')
    const email = ref('')
    const password = ref('')
    const confirmPassword = ref('')

    const passwordMismatchError = computed(() => {
      return password.value !== confirmPassword.value ? ['Passwords do not match'] : []
    })

    const submitForm = () => {
      if (password.value !== confirmPassword.value) {
        return
      }
      emit('register', {
        username: username.value,
        email: email.value,
        password: password.value,
      })
    }

    return {
      username,
      email,
      password,
      confirmPassword,
      submitForm,
      passwordMismatchError
    }
  }
}
</script>
